title: Internal documents leaked by Cisco workers angry over the company's ties to Israel's military show how it expanded its business as the war in Gaza dragged on (Alice Speri/The Guardian)
summary: Alice Speri / The Guardian: Internal documents leaked by Cisco workers angry over the company's ties to Israel's military show how it expanded its business as the war in Gaza dragged on — Tech giant leaped to shore up relationship even as company was roiled by worker protest over its role in the war
